input.source:
SERVICE ADDENDUM

1. Definitions
Service means the subscription service described in the order form.

2. Retention
Customer records are retained for 24 months after the end of the subscription.

3. Support
Support is available on business days only.
Emergency support is available for 24 hours a day.
input.summary:
The addendum governs the subscription service.
Customer records are retained for 24 months after the end of the subscription.
Support is available on business days only.
Emergency support is available for 24 hours a day.

cases.rationale: The definition is dropped, but it is not part of the support brief. A detector that flags every dropped sentence is useless.
